articles.title: Death toll in Spain border crisis reaches 67 as tens of thousands cross back in to Morocco
articles.summary: The death toll in Spain's Ceuta border crisis with Morocco has climbed to 67. They included some who drowned and some who were killed in a stampede to cross a breakwater barrier.
articles.titleZh: 西班牙边境危机造成67人死亡，数万人返回摩洛哥
articles.summaryZh: 西班牙休达与摩洛哥边境危机的死亡人数已攀升至67人。其中一些人溺水身亡，还有一些人在跨越防波堤屏障的踩踏事件中丧生。

contentParagraphs.en: Migrants return to Morocco from the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, Saturday, Aug. 1, 2026.
contentParagraphs.zh: 2026 年 8 月 1 日星期六，移民从西班牙飞地休达返回摩洛哥。

contentParagraphs.en: CEUTA, Spain — The death toll in Spain's Ceuta border crisis with Morocco has climbed to 67, the Spanish government said Saturday. They included some who drowned and some who were killed in a stampede to cross a breakwater barrier.
contentParagraphs.zh: 西班牙休达——西班牙政府周六表示，西班牙与摩洛哥之间的休达边境危机造成的死亡人数已攀升至 67 人。其中一些人溺水身亡，还有一些人在跨越防波堤屏障的踩踏事件中丧生。

contentParagraphs.en: Spain announced it was installing a 500-meter-long containment barrier along the breakwater fence into the sea after some 60,000 migrants breached the tiny Spanish territory's frontier between Thursday and Friday.
contentParagraphs.zh: 周四至周五，约 6 万名移民闯入西班牙这片狭小的领土的边境后，西班牙宣布将沿着防波堤围栏安装 500 米长的隔离屏障入海。

contentParagraphs.en: A handful of exhausted migrants who swam to Ceuta's urban Tarajal beach Saturday morning were met by soldiers who escorted them back across the border. Spain's interior ministry says the majority of those who entered the Spanish territory in North Africa have already returned to Morocco.
contentParagraphs.zh: 周六早上，几名精疲力竭的移民游到休达市区塔拉哈尔海滩，士兵们遇到了他们，护送他们穿过边境返回。西班牙内政部表示，进入西班牙北非领土的大多数人已经返回摩洛哥。

contentParagraphs.en: After days of chaos and streets packed with people who had hoped for a better life in Spain, residents of Ceuta woke up Saturday to an uneasy calm.
contentParagraphs.zh: 经过几天的混乱，街道上挤满了希望在西班牙过上更好生活的人，休达的居民周六醒来时感到不安的平静。

contentParagraphs.en: Even so, security for residents of the autonomous city of 84,000 remained bruised.
contentParagraphs.zh: 即便如此，这个拥有 84,000 名居民的自治城市的安全仍然受到损害。

contentParagraphs.en: "Life in this city has been disrupted as a result of the border incident," said Ceuta's President Juan Jesus Vivas.
contentParagraphs.zh: 休达总统胡安·热苏斯·维瓦斯表示：“边境事件扰乱了这座城市的生活。”

contentParagraphs.en: "The return of people has begun satisfactorily but the process must be completed," he said. "The city has not yet returned to normal."
contentParagraphs.zh: 他说：“人们的返回工作已经顺利开始，但这一过程必须完成。” “这座城市还没有恢复正常。”

contentParagraphs.en: Some determined migrants, however, remained in Ceuta. Among them was Mohamed Hatri, a 23-year-old Moroccan.
contentParagraphs.zh: 然而，一些坚定的移民仍留在休达。其中包括 23 岁的摩洛哥人穆罕默德·哈特里 (Mohamed Hatri)。

contentParagraphs.en: "They've closed everything down so that we can't buy anything to eat, to force us to return to our country," he said.
contentParagraphs.zh: “他们关闭了一切，让我们买不到任何东西吃，迫使我们返回我们的国家，”他说。

contentParagraphs.en: "But even if they close it down … we're round to stay here, whether we're hungry or not."
contentParagraphs.zh: “但即使他们关闭了……我们也会留在这里，无论我们饿不饿。”

articles.title: For sale: early access to Trump's Truth Social posts
articles.summary: The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month. Experts say the service may violate insider trading laws.
articles.titleZh: 出售：抢先访问特朗普的真相社交帖子
articles.summaryZh: 总统的媒体公司为投资者提供提前访问他的 Truth Social 信息流的机会，每月费用高达 10 万美元。专家表示，该服务可能违反内幕交易法。

contentParagraphs.en: President Donald Trump holds up a copy of his Truth Social post about Air Force One as he speaks with the media aboard Air Force One on July 8, 2026. The president's media company is offering investors early access to his Truth Social feed for up to $100,000 a month, raising ethical and legal concerns.
contentParagraphs.zh: 2026 年 7 月 8 日，唐纳德·特朗普总统在空军一号上接受媒体采访时，手举一份有关空军一号的 Truth Social 帖子。总统的媒体公司向投资者提供提前访问他的 Truth Social 供稿的机会，每月费用高达 10 万美元，这引起了道德和法律方面的担忧。

contentParagraphs.en: President Trump, his critics like to say, learned one major lesson during his first term: Never leave any money on the table.
contentParagraphs.zh: 特朗普总统的批评者喜欢说，他在第一个任期内学到了一个重要教训：永远不要留下任何钱。

contentParagraphs.en: But even for a president who raked in $2 billion, fueled mostly by his lucrative cryptocurrency ventures, the latest offering from his social media platform, Truth Social, stands out.
contentParagraphs.zh: 但即使对于一位主要靠利润丰厚的加密货币投资赚得 20 亿美元的总统来说，他的社交媒体平台 Truth Social 的最新产品也脱颖而出。

contentParagraphs.en: Trump Media & Technology Group is now shopping to traders and investors a premium version of Truth Social delivering early access to the feeds of high-profile users, including the president.
contentParagraphs.zh: 特朗普媒体与科技集团现在正在向交易者和投资者购买Truth Social的高级版本，让他们可以尽早访问包括总统在内的知名用户的动态。

contentParagraphs.en: Starting Saturday, for a fee of up to $100,000 a month, trading firms can access "Truth API" to get a glimpse of the president's often market-moving announcements about economic policy and global affairs before the rest of the world.
contentParagraphs.zh: 从周六开始，贸易公司每月支付高达 10 万美元的费用，就可以访问“Truth API”，以了解总统在世界其他地区之前发布的有关经济政策和全球事务的经常影响市场的公告。

contentParagraphs.en: Trump's media company says customers have already started signing up. Such an offering would give institutional investors a leg up in areas of finance like high-frequency trading, where an advantage of a few milliseconds can mean the difference of millions of dollars. But will the service be widely adopted across Wall Street?
contentParagraphs.zh: 特朗普的媒体公司表示，客户已经开始注册。这样的产品将使机构投资者在高频交易等金融领域占据优势，在这些领域，几毫秒的优势可能意味着数百万美元的差异。但这项服务会被整个华尔街广泛采用吗？

contentParagraphs.en: "It's insane," said one Wall Street executive, who requested anonymity for fear of retaliation from the Trump administration. "I can say for myself and 200 of my friends in finance, we're not getting anywhere near this. In another administration, this would be considered criminal."
contentParagraphs.zh: 一位华尔街高管表示：“这太疯狂了。”由于担心遭到特朗普政府的报复，该高管要求匿名。 “我可以对我自己和我的 200 位金融界朋友说，我们还远远没有达到这个目标。在另一届政府中，这将被视为犯罪。”

contentParagraphs.en: NPR reached out to 12 other major players in finance, brokers, hedge fund managers and other investors. None would speak publicly about the service, with some saying the risk of landing in Trump's crosshairs was too high.
contentParagraphs.zh: NPR 联系了金融界、经纪人、对冲基金经理和其他投资者中的其他 12 个主要参与者。没有人愿意公开谈论这项服务，一些人表示成为特朗普瞄准目标的风险太高。

contentParagraphs.en: Former SEC official says Truth API appears illegal
contentParagraphs.zh: 前 SEC 官员称 Truth API 似乎非法

contentParagraphs.en: Securities experts, however, are drawing attention to the legal concerns surrounding the service.
contentParagraphs.zh: 然而，证券专家正在提请人们注意围绕该服务的法律问题。

contentParagraphs.en: Renée Jones, a Boston College professor and former top official at the Securities and Exchange Commission, said the paid offering appears to run afoul of insider trading laws.
contentParagraphs.zh: 波士顿学院教授、美国证券交易委员会前高级官员蕾妮·琼斯表示，此次付费发行似乎违反了内幕交易法。

contentParagraphs.en: She pointed to federal securities laws prohibiting schemes in which non-public information is misused to give a trader an unfair advantage. The law states that sharing such information is a breach of "a duty or trust of confidence."
contentParagraphs.zh: 她指出，联邦证券法禁止滥用非公开信息为交易者提供不公平优势的计划。法律规定，分享此类信息违反“义务或信任”。

contentParagraphs.en: "So if the president's Truth Social posts are being monetized, and if some people get special access to them, that's misappropriated information," Jones said. "And by giving people his posts early, he is also violating his duty of trust and confidence."
contentParagraphs.zh: “因此，如果总统的真相社会帖子被货币化，并且如果某些人获得特殊访问权限，那就是盗用信息，”琼斯说。 “而且，他过早地向人们授予职位，也违反了他的信任和信心义务。”

contentParagraphs.en: Offering specialized data access to paying customers is not unusual or illegal for social media companies. But given that Trump regularly announces or hints at official government policy via Truth Social, the paid service could quickly run into legal problems, according to Jones.
contentParagraphs.zh: 对于社交媒体公司来说，向付费客户提供专门的数据访问权限并不罕见或违法。但琼斯表示，考虑到特朗普经常通过 Truth Social 宣布或暗示官方政府政策，这项付费服务​​可能很快就会遇到法律问题。

contentParagraphs.en: She pointed to the 2012 Stock Act, which prohibits members of Congress and the executive branch, including the president, from trading stocks based on privileged information.
contentParagraphs.zh: 她提到了 2012 年《股票法案》，该法案禁止国会议员和包括总统在内的行政部门根据特权信息交易股票。

contentParagraphs.en: "That said, I could imagine Trump's lawyers arguing that because they announced it out in the open, it's not deceitful, it's not fraudulent," Jones said.
contentParagraphs.zh: “话虽如此，我可以想象特朗普的律师会辩称，因为他们是公开宣布的，所以这不是欺骗，不是欺诈，”琼斯说。

contentParagraphs.en: Shannon Devine, a spokeswoman for Trump Media & Technology Group, said in a statement that offering an early preview of posts from the president and others does not amount to insider trading.
contentParagraphs.zh: 特朗普媒体与科技集团发言人香农·迪瓦恩(Shannon Devine)在一份声明中表示，提供总统和其他人帖子的早期预览并不构成内幕交易。

contentParagraphs.en: "Truth API offers customers the fastest way to ingest publicly available Truth Social data. Critics must have invented a new theory of 'insider trading' based on publicly available information," Devine said.
contentParagraphs.zh: “Truth API 为客户提供了获取公开的真相社交数据的最快方式。批评者一定是根据公开信息发明了一种新的‘内幕交易’理论，”Devine 说。

contentParagraphs.en: Democratic Senators demand SEC investigation
contentParagraphs.zh: 民主党参议员要求 SEC 调查

contentParagraphs.en: Democratic Senators have called on federal regulators to probe whether Truth API is indeed breaking securities law.
contentParagraphs.zh: 民主党参议员呼吁联邦监管机构调查 Truth API 是否确实违反了证券法。

contentParagraphs.en: In a letter sent Wednesday to the SEC by Sens. Elizabeth Warren of Massachusetts and Adam Schiff of California, the lawmakers called the service "an outrageous abuse of the President's office for his personal benefit that undermines everyday investors and the integrity of our markets." They asked the commission to launch an investigation.
contentParagraphs.zh: 马萨诸塞州参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦 (Elizabeth Warren) 和加利福尼亚州参议员亚当·希夫 (Adam Schiff) 在周三致美国证券交易委员会的一封信中称，这项服务“是为了个人利益而对总统办公室的粗暴滥用，损害了日常投资者和我们市场的诚信。”他们要求委员会展开调查。

contentParagraphs.en: The SEC declined to comment.
contentParagraphs.zh: 美国证券交易委员会拒绝发表评论。

contentParagraphs.en: Trump Media & Technology Group spokeswoman Devine dismissed the letter as partisan wrangling.
contentParagraphs.zh: 特朗普媒体与科技集团发言人迪瓦恩将这封信斥为党派之争。

contentParagraphs.en: "With no apparent sense of irony, certain politicians falsely accuse us of anti-free-market behavior while pressuring businesses into boycotting a product, all in a coordinated effort to harm a publicly traded company," Devine said.
contentParagraphs.zh: 迪瓦恩表示：“某些政客毫无明显讽刺意味，错误地指责我们有反自由市场行为，同时向企业施压抵制某种产品，所有这些都是为了损害一家上市公司。”

contentParagraphs.en: Trump is the largest shareholder of his media company through a trust controlled by his eldest son, Donald Trump Jr., regulatory filings show.
contentParagraphs.zh: 监管文件显示，特朗普通过其长子小唐纳德·特朗普控制的信托基金成为其媒体公司的最大股东。

contentParagraphs.en: That means the Trump family's wealth will grow as customers sign up for Truth API.
contentParagraphs.zh: 这意味着随着客户注册 Truth API，特朗普家族的财富将会增长。

contentParagraphs.en: It's the latest example of the president blurring the lines between public office and his business empire.
contentParagraphs.zh: 这是总统模糊公职与其商业帝国之间界限的最新例子。

contentParagraphs.en: "Channeling nonpublic information to Trump's media company for high-speed dissemination to his wealthy institutional investors is a step toward normalizing insider trading that undermines the integrity of U.S. markets and further erodes investor confidence," said Virginia Canter, a former SEC lawyer who is now with Democracy Defenders Fund, a nonprofit that has been critical of the Trump administration.
contentParagraphs.zh: “将非公开信息传递给特朗普的媒体公司，以便向他富有的机构投资者高速传播，是内幕交易正常化的一步，这会破坏美国市场的诚信，并进一步削弱投资者的信心，”美国证券交易委员会前律师、现任民主捍卫者基金的弗吉尼亚·坎特表示，该基金是一个一直批评特朗普政府的非营利组织。

contentParagraphs.en: Canter added that the product "disadvantages regular investors who unfortunately may be on the losing sides of those trades because they do not have the same access to information."
contentParagraphs.zh: 坎特补充说，该产品“对普通投资者不利，不幸的是，他们可能会在这些交易中遭受损失，因为他们无法获得相同的信息。”

contentParagraphs.en: The Wall Street executive who requested anonymity asked: "Should he be able to monetize the office of the presidency like this? I don't think so. But will investment banks stick their neck out over it? Probably not."
contentParagraphs.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的华尔街高管问道：“他应该能够像这样将总统办公室货币化吗？我不这么认为。但是投资银行会对此不遗余力吗？可能不会。”

articles.title: FIFA scraps controversial deal to sell stakes in World Cup to private investors
articles.summary: FIFA abandoned a plan to create a commercial venture and then sell stakes to minority investors, just days after unveiling it. The plan drew sharp condemnation — and a boycott from European nations.
articles.titleZh: 国际足联取消了有争议的向私人投资者出售世界杯股份的交易
articles.summaryZh: 国际足联放弃了一项创建商业企业，然后将股份出售给少数投资者的计划，就在该计划公布几天后。该计划遭到了严厉谴责，并遭到欧洲国家的抵制。

contentParagraphs.en: FIFA President Gianni Infantino poses with the World Cup trophy following the 2026 FIFA World Cup European Play-Off draw at the FIFA's Home of Football in Zurich on Nov. 20, 2025.
contentParagraphs.zh: 2025 年 11 月 20 日，2026 年国际足联世界杯欧洲附加赛抽签仪式在苏黎世国际足联足球之家举行，国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺与世界杯奖杯合影。

contentParagraphs.en: FIFA on Friday abandoned a controversial plan to sell stakes in the World Cup to private investors after drawing vociferous opposition from European countries — and from its own ranks.
contentParagraphs.zh: 在遭到欧洲国家和国际足联内部的强烈反对后，国际足联周五放弃了一项有争议的向私人投资者出售世界杯股份的计划。

contentParagraphs.en: The swift about-face marks a stunning defeat for FIFA President Gianni Infantino, who had championed a plan announced on Tuesday to create a commercial venture to capitalize on its tournaments — including the World Cup and the Club World Cup. The decision came just weeks after the conclusion of its enormously lucrative men's tournament held across North America.
contentParagraphs.zh: 这一迅速的转变标志着国际足联主席詹尼·因凡蒂诺的惨败，他曾支持周二宣布的一项计划，即创建一家商业企业，以利用包括世界杯和世俱杯在内的世界杯赛事。这一决定是在北美举办的利润丰厚的男子锦标赛结束几周后做出的。

contentParagraphs.en: The most controversial part of the plan was a deal to sell a minority stake to private investors including a firm run by Joshua Kushner, the brother of President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner.
contentParagraphs.zh: 该计划最具争议的部分是向私人投资者出售少数股权的交易，其中包括特朗普总统女婿贾里德·库什纳的兄弟约书亚·库什纳经营的一家公司。

contentParagraphs.en: "Having listened carefully to all the views, it has become clear that the project has created divisions of a nature that, regardless of the level of support, are no longer in the interest of the objective set out in the first place," Infantino said in a statement.
contentParagraphs.zh: 因凡蒂诺在一份声明中表示：“在仔细听取了所有意见后，很明显，该项目已经造成了一定程度的分歧，无论支持程度如何，都不再符合最初设定的目标。”

contentParagraphs.en: "Our purpose has always been - and will always be - to unite and improve," he added. "As a result, this proposal will not proceed."
contentParagraphs.zh: 他补充说：“我们的目标一直是，也将永远是，团结和进步。” “因此，这项提议不会继续进行。”

contentParagraphs.en: European nations threatened to boycott the World Cup
contentParagraphs.zh: 欧洲国家威胁抵制世界杯

contentParagraphs.en: Infantino's plan had drawn swift opposition from the minute it was unveiled.
contentParagraphs.zh: 因凡蒂诺的计划一公布就立即遭到反对。

contentParagraphs.en: European nations strongly opposed the plan, taking the unprecedented step of saying they would boycott the World Cup unless FIFA abandoned it entirely. UEFA, the region's soccer governing body, had said such a deal would amount to the "sale" of football.
contentParagraphs.zh: 欧洲国家强烈反对这一计划，并史无前例地表示，除非国际足联完全放弃世界杯，否则他们将抵制世界杯。该地区的足球管理机构欧足联曾表示，这样的交易相当于“出售”足球。

contentParagraphs.en: CONCACAF, which represents North and Central America as well as the Caribbean, along with the AFC, which represents Asia, had also opposed the plan, although they did not go as far as threatening to boycott the tournament.
contentParagraphs.zh: 代表北美、中美洲以及加勒比地区的中北美洲及加勒比海足球协会和代表亚洲的亚足联也反对这一计划，尽管他们没有威胁抵制这项赛事。

contentParagraphs.en: Spain lifts the World Cup trophy in the tournament final after defeating Argentina at New York New Jersey Stadium in East Rutherford, N.J., on July 19, 2026.
contentParagraphs.zh: 2026 年 7 月 19 日，西班牙队在新泽西州东卢瑟福的纽约新泽西体育场击败阿根廷队，在世界杯决赛中捧起世界杯奖杯。

contentParagraphs.en: It also drew opposition from FIFA's own ranks, in what was another huge blow to Infantino.
contentParagraphs.zh: 这也引起了国际足联内部的反对，这对因凡蒂诺来说是又一次巨大的打击。

contentParagraphs.en: A top adviser to the FIFA President, Carlos Cordeiro, resigned from his post earlier in the day, citing his opposition to the plan. And then, the organization's chief operating officer, Kevin Lamour, harshly came out against the plan, releasing a statement to the Associated Press, saying FIFA's staff had been blindsided by it. Lamour also called it the "project of one person," in reference to Infantino — and then added he was willing to be fired over his statement, saying " At least I'll sleep well tonight."
contentParagraphs.zh: 国际足联主席的高级顾问卡洛斯·科代罗当天早些时候辞职，理由是他反对该计划。随后，该组织首席运营官凯文·拉莫尔严厉反对该计划，并向美联社发表声明，称国际足联的工作人员对此感到措手不及。拉莫尔还称其为“一个人的项目”，指的是因凡蒂诺，然后补充说，他愿意因自己的言论而被解雇，并说“至少我今晚会睡个好觉”。

contentParagraphs.en: All eyes on FIFA chief Infantino's future
contentParagraphs.zh: 所有人都关注国际足联主席因凡蒂诺的未来

contentParagraphs.en: The plan marks a big setback for Infantino, who had just overseen the most lucrative World Cup in history, with FIFA set to raise $15 billion over the past four years, the bulk of it from the men's tournament that took place across North America this year.
contentParagraphs.zh: 这一计划对因凡蒂诺来说是一个重大挫折，他刚刚主持了历史上最赚钱的世界杯，国际足联计划在过去四年筹集 150 亿美元，其中大部分来自今年在北美举行的男子世界杯。

contentParagraphs.en: But Infantino has also faced a series of controversies, from the backlash over sky-high ticket prices to FIFA's controversial decision to award a "Peace Prize" to President Trump.
contentParagraphs.zh: 但因凡蒂诺也面临一系列争议，从天价票价的强烈反对，到国际足联向特朗普总统颁发“和平奖”的争议决定。

contentParagraphs.en: FIFA also suspended a red card given to U.S. men's national team Folarin Balogun after Trump and his administration petitioned the organization to re-examine its decision.
contentParagraphs.zh: 在特朗普及其政府请求国际足联重新审查其决定后，国际足联还暂停了向美国男子国家队福拉林·巴洛贡发出的红牌。

contentParagraphs.en: Infantino, who's widely believed to be running for a third term when his current one expires next year, had pointed to the billions FIFA had raked in, most of which will be spread out across FIFA's 211 members.
contentParagraphs.zh: 人们普遍认为，因凡蒂诺将在明年现任任期届满后竞选第三个任期。他指出，国际足联已经获得了数十亿美元的收入，其中大部分将分配给国际足联的 211 名会员。

contentParagraphs.en: But his plan to sell stakes in the World Cup was seen as a step too far, leaving him facing intense pressure not only from outside, but now also from within FIFA.
contentParagraphs.zh: 但他出售世界杯股份的计划被认为太过分了，这让他不仅面临着来自外部的巨大压力，现在还面临着来自国际足联内部的巨大压力。

contentParagraphs.en: In his statement, Infantino said he would work to mend fences.
contentParagraphs.zh: 因凡蒂诺在声明中表示，他将努力修补关系。

contentParagraphs.en: "Moving forward, my intent is to bring all interested parties back together in the coming days and weeks in the spirit of shared interest in our game, and with the objective to continue growing football everywhere, particularly in those countries that mostly need our support," he said.
contentParagraphs.zh: “展望未来，我的目的是在未来几天和几周内，本着对我们比赛的共同兴趣的精神，让所有感兴趣的各方重新聚集在一起，目标是继续在世界各地发展足球，特别是在那些最需要我们支持的国家，”他说。

articles.title: Scientist's lifelong obsession with mystery of elusive 'pink zebra' seaweed
articles.summary: An ancient algae first spotted four decades ago will now join the collection of the Natural History Museum.
articles.titleZh: 科学家终生痴迷于难以捉摸的“粉红斑马”海藻之谜
articles.summaryZh: 四十年前首次发现的一种古老藻类现在将被纳入自然历史博物馆的收藏中。

contentParagraphs.en: ByHarriet BradshawThe Great Barrier Reef might be the world's most famous underwater ecosystem, but hidden in UK waters lies an ancient marine world you may not have heard of.Known as maerl beds, these carpets of coral-like seaweed create some of the richest habitats in the sea.And 40 years ago, while studying one such bed for her PhD, Prof Christine Maggs found a fragment of pink-striped seaweed living on maerl she had never seen before.The discovery would become a lifelong obsession and a decades-long scientific puzzle.Image source, Francis BunkerImage caption, New ceramium is an entirely new species unknown to scienceMaerl beds may closely resemble corals but they are in fact thousands of pieces of free-living calcified seaweed that can interlock to create a carpet brimming with life.Hours of trawling through the literature seemed to confirm that no-one else had known what this little seaweed that lived on maerl was either. Prof Maggs suspected it was a new species to science.But she needed a larger piece for a formal identification.She continued the hunt after her PhD, and the tiny seaweed would accompany her throughout her career, with fleeting glimpses including once on an underwater animal called a sea squirt, although never enough material to pin its identity down.Image caption, The Natural History Museum collection of seaweed pressings which the new species has joinedBut then two years ago, researchers surveying maerl beds in Cornwall found a sample, which they thought might be Prof Maggs' elusive seaweed.Prof Maggs bought a wine fridge in anticipation, the perfect dark, cool environment to store it while tests were carried out to prove it was, indeed, a new species."I just kept hoping that I would find out, it's been over four decades," she said.She has now shared the discovery exclusively with the BBC, and a sample of the species has joined the Natural History Museum's official collection.Image source, Angie GallImage caption, Maerl bed in the Fal estuaryThe scientific divers who found the sample were mapping and analysing seaweeds to check on the health of Cornish maerl beds, a project organised by Natural England.This type of diving is specialised and expensive, involving difficult logistics and a large amount of equipment. But for the researchers involved, the experience is extremely rewarding."It's such a privilege to go diving somewhere like this and you never get long enough. It's different every single time," Angie Gall at Natural England says.They have seen spider crabs taking a stroll, starfish, king scallops and goby fish.Amongst the collection of bags brought up on one such Cornish trip were cuttings of a small red algae which was pink-banded with pincer tips.Image source, Prof. Curt PueschelImage caption, Christine Maggs in 1982 in a home-made drysuit with her PhD supervisor Mike Guiry beside herFrancis Bunker, a freelance and independent marine biologist, kept finding the tiny seaweed in samples he had collected on that survey."I suppose you've got to be a bit nerdy," he says, explaining he takes a magnifying glass with him diving. "You've got to be awed by it all, which I never cease to be."He suspected the tiny seaweed might be what Prof Maggs had long been searching for. He gathered as much as he could and sent it to her in London.Prof Maggs needed to grow the seaweed big enough to be DNA sequenced. She turned to her trusty cool chamber - the wine fridge."This particular seaweed is so small I needed to get some molecular data," Prof Maggs explains. "That's why this has taken me 40 years."Image source, Francis BunkerBut the wait was worth it. With the help of Prof Beatriz de Barros Barreto, who worked on the DNA sequencing, Prof Maggs has put the pieces of the puzzle together to reveal the seaweed is indeed new to science."We knew that maerl was a rich, biodiverse habitat, but we didn't necessarily realise that we'd be still finding new species that live on that maerl," Prof Maggs says."It's great," Bunker adds. "I think it's what spurs you on really, finding a new species. It's like the icing on the cake, or the cherry on top."Prof Maggs' findings are soon to be published in the peer-reviewed journal Phycologia.Image caption, Professor Christine Maggs at workSeaweeds are one of the most ancient forms of life - having developed more than 1bn years ago - and many provide a critical food source for fish and a haven for them to lay their eggs.For humans, the abundant minerals and anti-inflammatory properties of certain seaweeds have seen their extracts used in medicines from treating acid reflux to wound dressings."We really have to look after seaweeds, we really have to love them," Prof Juliet Brodie, a leading seaweed expert, explains in the vaults of the Natural History Museum surrounded by a collection of seaweed pressings the new species is joining.Finding a new species, although exciting in itself, plays an important role in keeping an eye on the maerl's health over time."They're really precious," she adds. "I've often pondered to myself, what would the world be like without seaweeds? You would be taking away your nurseries for some of your economically important fish. But you would also [remove] the immense diversity that makes our world function."Image caption, Scientific divers on a maerl siteProf Craig Schneider, professor of biology at Trinity College Connecticut, who was not involved in the study, says the discovery of the new species is "significant" to science.He said it could also add to interest in protecting maerl beds, which were "already of the greatest importance to all of the other plants, animals and microbes in the ecological community that they support".Maerl beds are rare in Britain. They are classed as a threatened and declining habitat under the OSPAR convention - an international agreement for environmental protection in the North-East Atlantic.There are currently four protected maerl sites in the UK, including the Fal and Helford Speci
contentParagraphs.zh: 作者：Harriet Bradshaw 大堡礁可能是世界上最著名的水下生态系统，但在英国水域中隐藏着一个您可能没有听说过的古老海洋世界。这些珊瑚状海藻地毯被称为“maerl 床”，它们创造了海洋中最丰富的栖息地。40 年前，Christine Maggs 教授在研究这样的一张床攻读博士学位时，发现了一块生活在她从未见过的maerl 上的粉红色条纹海藻碎片。这一发现将成为一个终生的痴迷和一个长达数十年的科学难题。图片来源，弗朗西斯·邦克图片说明，新陶瓷是一种科学未知的全新物种。马尔床可能与珊瑚非常相似，但实际上它们是数千片自由生活的钙化海藻，它们可以相互连接，形成充满生命的地毯。数小时的文献搜寻似乎证实了没有人知道这种生活在马尔上的小海藻是什么。是。马格斯教授怀疑这是一个科学上的新物种。但她需要更大的一块来进行正式鉴定。她在获得博士学位后继续寻找这种微小的海藻，这种微小的海藻将伴随她的整个职业生涯，其中包括一次短暂的瞥见，包括一次看到一种叫做海鞘的水下动物，尽管没有足够的材料来确定它的身份。图片说明，自然历史博物馆收藏的新物种已加入海藻压制物但两年前，研究人员在康沃尔郡的马尔尔床调查中发现了一个样本，他们认为这可能是一个样本。马格斯教授满怀期待地买了一个葡萄酒冰箱，这是一个完美的黑暗、凉爽的环境来存放它，同时进行测试以证明它确实是一个新物种。“我一直希望我能找到答案，已经过去了四十多年了，”她说。她现在与 教授图片说明：1982 年，克里斯汀·马格斯 (Christine Maggs) 穿着自制的干衣，旁边是她的博士生导师迈克·吉里 (Francis Bunker)，一位自由职业者和独立海洋生物学家，不断在他在那次调查中收集的样本中发现微小的海藻。“我想你一定有点书呆子，”他说，解释说他潜水时带着放大镜。 “你一定会对这一切感到敬畏，我也从未停止过这种敬畏。”他怀疑这种微小的海藻可能就是马格斯教授长期以来一直在寻找的东西。他尽可能多地收集并发送给伦敦的她。马格斯教授需要种植足够大的海藻以便进行 DNA 测序。她转向她值得信赖的冷藏室——葡萄酒冰箱。“这种特殊的海藻是如此之小，我需要获得一些分子数据，”马格斯教授解释道。 “这就是为什么我花了 40 年的时间。”图片来源：Francis Bunker 但等待是值得的。在从事 DNA 测序工作的 Beatriz de Barros Barreto 教授的帮助下，马格斯教授将谜题拼凑起来，揭示了海藻确实是科学上的新事物。“我们知道马尔是一个丰富的、生物多样性的栖息地，但我们不一定意识到我们仍然会发现生活在那个马尔上的新物种，”马格斯教授说。“这太棒了，”邦克补充道。 “我认为这才是真正激励你发现新物种的动力。这就像锦上添花，或者是锦上添花。”马格斯教授的研究结果很快将发表在同行评审期刊《Phycologia》上。图片说明，克里斯汀·马格斯教授在工作海藻是最古老的生命形式之一——已经在十亿多年前形成——许多为鱼类提供了重要的食物来源，并为它们产卵提供了避风港。对人类来说，某些海藻的丰富矿物质和抗炎特性已被用于从治疗胃酸反流到伤口敷料等多种药物中。领先的海藻专家朱丽叶·布罗迪教授在自然历史博物馆的金库中解释说：“我们真的必须照顾海藻，我们真的必须爱护它们，”周围环绕着新物种加入的一系列海藻压制品。发现一个新物种虽然本身令人兴奋，但在关注海藻方面发挥着重要作用。随着时间的推移，马尔的健康状况越来越好。“它们真的很珍贵，”她补充道。 articles.title: Why did OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI models hack other companies?
articles.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models broke into other companies' systems during testing, raising security concerns amid a heated debate over how to regulate AI.
articles.titleZh: 为什么 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的人工智能模型会攻击其他公司？
articles.summaryZh: OpenAI 和 Anthropic 表示，他们的模型在测试过程中侵入了其他公司的系统，在关于如何监管​​人工智能的激烈争论中引发了安全担忧。

contentParagraphs.en: OpenAI and Anthropic say their models broke into other companies' systems during testing, raising security concerns amid a heated debate over how to regulate AI.
contentParagraphs.zh: OpenAI 和 Anthropic 表示，他们的模型在测试过程中侵入了其他公司的系统，在关于如何监管​​人工智能的激烈争论中引发了安全担忧。

contentParagraphs.en: Imen Ben Youssef/Hans Lucas/AFP via Getty Images
contentParagraphs.zh: Imen Ben Youssef/Hans Lucas/AFP via Getty Images

contentParagraphs.en: Imen Ben Youssef/Hans Lucas/AFP via Getty Images
contentParagraphs.zh: Imen Ben Youssef/Hans Lucas/AFP via Getty Images

contentParagraphs.en: Days after OpenAI disclosed that artificial intelligence systems tunneled out of their testing environment and broke into another company, rival Anthropic disclosed that its own AI models also hacked other companies during testing.
contentParagraphs.zh: 在 OpenAI 披露人工智能系统从其测试环境中挖出隧道并侵入另一家公司几天后，其竞争对手 Anthropic 披露其自己的人工智能模型也在测试过程中入侵了其他公司。

contentParagraphs.en: News of the attacks, which initially went unnoticed, is reverberating across Silicon Valley and Washington amid debates over how to address the advanced cybercapabilities of AI.
contentParagraphs.zh: 这些攻击的消息最初并未引起人们的注意，但在有关如何解决人工智能先进网络功能的争论中，这些消息在硅谷和华盛顿引起了反响。

contentParagraphs.en: While the two incidents are not of the same gravity, experts say they highlight the importance of setting up rigorous testing environments for advanced models and the need for robust cyberdefenses as autonomous hacking capabilities become more widespread in the future.
contentParagraphs.zh: 虽然这两起事件的严重程度不同，但专家表示，它们凸显了为先进模型建立严格测试环境的重要性，以及随着自主黑客能力在未来变得更加普遍而需要强大的网络防御。

contentParagraphs.en: Human error led to Anthropic hacks
contentParagraphs.zh: 人为错误导致人为黑客攻击

contentParagraphs.en: In a blog post published on Thursday, Anthropic said that in three separate incidents in recent months, AI models undergoing testing of their cybercapabilities hacked into three unsuspecting companies.
contentParagraphs.zh: Anthropic 在周四发表的一篇博客文章中表示，在近几个月的三起不同事件中，正在测试其网络能力的人工智能模型入侵了三家毫无戒心的公司。

contentParagraphs.en: Anthropic said the hacks were the result of a "misunderstanding" with an outside company that set up secure testing environments known as sandboxes, which erroneously gave the models access to the internet. Anthropic said the earliest incident happened in April, but that neither it nor the affected companies, which it didn't name, were aware of the hacks until now.
contentParagraphs.zh: Anthropic 表示，这些黑客攻击是与一家外部公司“误解”的结果，该公司建立了称为沙箱的安全测试环境，错误地让模型访问互联网。 Anthropic 表示，最早的事件发生在 4 月份，但该公司和受影响的公司（未透露名称）直到现在才意识到这些黑客攻击。

contentParagraphs.en: Anthropic said in each case, its models were given fictional targets to hack into. In one incident, a model hacked into a real company that shared a name with the fictional target and stole "several hundred rows of production data." In another incident, a model uploaded malware to a commonly used software registry for the coding language Python; the malware ended up stealing credentials from a security company that downloaded it.
contentParagraphs.zh: Anthropic 表示，在每种情况下，其模型都被赋予了虚构的攻击目标。在一次事件中，一个模型侵入了一家真实的公司，该公司与虚构目标同名，并窃取了“数百行生产数据”。在另一起事件中，模型将恶意软件上传到编码语言 Python 的常用软件注册表；该恶意软件最终窃取了下载它的安全公司的凭据。

contentParagraphs.en: OpenAI models went rogue in effort to cheat on evaluation
contentParagraphs.zh: OpenAI 模型在评估中作弊而出轨

contentParagraphs.en: Anthropic's review of its records was spurred by OpenAI's announcement last week that its own models went rogue in testing.
contentParagraphs.zh: OpenAI 上周宣布其自己的模型在测试中出现问题，这促使 Anthropic 对其记录进行了审查。

contentParagraphs.en: OpenAI said that in an attempt to cheat on the cyber-evaluation they were given, its models found and exploited a vulnerability previously unknown to the company to escape their sandbox and access the internet. The models correctly inferred that the answer to the evaluation was available on Hugging Face, a digital library of AI models and software, and broke into the company's systems. Hugging Face detected the intrusion with its own AI models.
contentParagraphs.zh: OpenAI 表示，为了欺骗他们获得的网络评估，其模型发现并利用了该公司之前未知的漏洞来逃脱沙箱并访问互联网。这些模型正确地推断出评估的答案可以在人工智能模型和软件的数字图书馆 Hugging Face 上找到，并侵入该公司的系统。 Hugging Face 使用自己的人工智能模型检测到了入侵。

contentParagraphs.en: "We consider this incident to be an unprecedented cyber incident, involving state-of-the-art cyber capabilities, and are responding accordingly," OpenAI stated in a blog post about the hack.
contentParagraphs.zh: OpenAI 在一篇有关此次黑客攻击的博客文章中表示：“我们认为这是一次前所未有的网络事件，涉及最先进的网络能力，并正在做出相应的反应。”

contentParagraphs.en: There are some key differences between what happened at the two AI companies. Like the OpenAI models, Anthropic's models hacked into third-party websites during testing. However, unlike OpenAI's agents, there was no indication, according to the company's blog post, that the models were trying to cheat on their evaluations. And unlike the case involving OpenAI, the models did not exploit previously unknown vulnerabilities, or what are known as "zero day" exploits.
contentParagraphs.zh: 两家人工智能公司所发生的事情存在一些关键差异。与 OpenAI 模型一样，Anthropic 的模型在测试期间侵入了第三方网站。然而，与 OpenAI 的代理不同的是，根据该公司的博客文章，没有迹象表明这些模型试图在评估中作弊。与 OpenAI 的案例不同，这些模型没有利用以前未知的漏洞，或者所谓的“零日”漏洞。

contentParagraphs.en: Once Hugging Face detected the OpenAI attack, it initially tried to use Anthropic's top-tier Claude Opus and Fable models for defense, but the models refused to help. "Their safety guardrails treated reverse-engineering an exploit the same as launching one," Hugging Face stated in a blog post. The company then turned to a model from Chinese company Z.ai to defend itself.
contentParagraphs.zh: Hugging Face 检测到 OpenAI 攻击后，最初尝试使用 Anthropic 的顶级 Claude Opus 和 Fable 模型进行防御，但这些模型拒绝提供帮助。 Hugging Face 在一篇博客文章中表示：“他们的安全护栏将逆向工程漏洞视为与启动漏洞一样。”随后，该公司转向中国公司再爱科技的模式来保护自己。

contentParagraphs.en: "U.S. models are harder to use for defensive purposes due to the restrictions that the White House has put in place," said Alex Stamos, the chief product officer of Corridor, an AI software security company. The U.S. government initially forced Anthropic to suspend Fable from public release in June, citing cybersecurity concerns. Two weeks later, Anthropic reached an agreement with the government to make the model available. But the company said in a blog post that it installed a new safety guardrail that would cause the model to reject some "benign requests."
contentParagraphs.zh: 人工智能软件安全公司 Corridor 的首席产品官亚历克斯·斯塔莫斯 (Alex Stamos) 表示：“由于白宫实施的限制，美国模型更难用于防御目的。”美国政府最初以网络安全问题为由，在 6 月份强迫 Anthropic 暂停《神鬼寓言》的公开发行。两周后，Anthropic 与政府达成协议，提供该模型。但该公司在一篇博客文章中表示，它安装了一个新的安全护栏，这将导致该模型拒绝一些“善意的请求”。

contentParagraphs.en: Shoring up defenses in a world of autonomous hacking
contentParagraphs.zh: 在自主黑客世界中加强防御

contentParagraphs.en: During testing for cybercapabilities, OpenAI and Anthropic remove some safety guardrails from their models, including ones that would make them likely to refuse to exploit software flaws. Cybersecurity researchers say given that, the companies could do more to keep their sandboxes watertight.
contentParagraphs.zh: 在网络功能测试过程中，OpenAI 和 Anthropic 从他们的模型中删除了一些安全护栏，包括那些可能使他们拒绝利用软件缺陷的安全护栏。网络安全研究人员表示，鉴于此，这些公司可以采取更多措施来保持沙箱的防水。

contentParagraphs.en: "I think that these sorts of incidents are preventable, but it requires oversight and foresight," said Colin Shea-Blymyer, a research fellow at Georgetown University who studies the intersection of cybersecurity and AI.
contentParagraphs.zh: “我认为这类事件是可以预防的，但需要监督和远见，”乔治城大学研究网络安全和人工智能交叉的研究员科林·谢伊·布莱迈尔 (Colin Shea-Blymyer) 说。

contentParagraphs.en: "If OpenAI really thought that their AI system, their agent, was going to be powerful, they could have asked the agent to evaluate the sandbox for any vulnerabilities in it before putting it in the sandbox," he said. "Beyond that, they could have had another AI system reading the outputs of the AI system that they were testing to see if it was doing anything unexpected."
contentParagraphs.zh: “如果 OpenAI 真的认为他们的人工智能系统、他们的代理将会很强大，他们可以要求代理在将其放入沙箱之前评估沙箱中是否存在任何漏洞，”他说。 “除此之外，他们还可以让另一个人工智能系统读取他们正在测试的人工智能系统的输出，看看它是否做了任何意想不到的事情。”

contentParagraphs.en: Anthropic said in the Thursday blog post that "recognizing that a target is real and stopping without being prompted" is behavior the company wants to see in all its models, even with some safety guardrails removed. However, the company said only the latest model it tested stopped once it realized it was on the internet and recognized it was targeting a real company. "Even that model went further before stopping than we would want," Anthropic said in its post.
contentParagraphs.zh: Anthropic 在周四的博客文章中表示，“认识到目标是真实的，并在没有提示的情况下停止”是该公司希望在其所有模型中看到的行为，即使删除了一些安全护栏。然而，该公司表示，只有当它意识到它在互联网上并认识到它的目标是一家真正的公司时，它测试的最新型号才会停止。 Anthropic 在其帖子中表示：“即使该模型在停止之前也超出了我们的预期。”

contentParagraphs.en: The hacks come as the Trump administration and lawmakers are pushing to regulate the most powerful AI companies but have not yet agreed on how to do so. President Trump signed an executive order in June asking AI companies to voluntarily submit their most powerful models for government testing before releasing them to the public.
contentParagraphs.zh: 这些黑客攻击发生之际，特朗普政府和立法者正在推动监管最强大的人工智能公司，但尚未就如何监管达成一致。特朗普总统于 6 月签署了一项行政命令，要求人工智能公司在向公众发布之前自愿提交最强大的模型供政府测试。

articles.title: Sainsbury's agrees to sell Argos for £120m
articles.summary: Under the terms of the deal, Argos will still operate in Sainsbury's shops, sell Habitat products, and offer Nectar points.
articles.titleZh: Sainsbury's 同意以 1.2 亿英镑出售 Argos
articles.summaryZh: 根据交易条款，Argos 仍将在 Sainsbury 的商店中运营、销售 Habitat 产品并提供 Nectar 积分。

contentParagraphs.en: Sainsbury's has agreed to sell Argos for £120m after a long process of trying to offload it as the supermarket chain aims to focus on its main food business.Sainsbury's said it would be "business as usual" for Argos customers, staff, and suppliers. Shoppers will see no change as Argos will still operate in Sainsbury's shops, sell Habitat products, and offer Nectar points.The buyer, Swift Partners, is a company that has been created to buy the brand and includes former Co-operative Group boss Richard Pennycook.There are 667 Argos shops across the UK, with 201 operating as standalone stores and 466 operating within Sainsbury's. It also has more than 450 collection points.Founded in 1973, Argos opened shops where customers browsed its catalogues and placed their orders, with products being delivered to tills from warehouses connected to the stores.The Argos catalogue, once described by comedian Bill Bailey as the "laminated book of dreams", used to be a physical book.Argos no longer prints this hefty tome, with its full range now available online instead. In store, customers can browse the product collection on tablet computers.Sainsbury's has been trying to sell Argos - which has been seen as an underperforming brand - for some time.Sainsbury's bought Argos – together with Habitat and all the other retail brands owned by Home Retail Group – in 2016 for £1.4bn. It then sold Argos financial services, which runs the Argos card, for around £720m in 2024.In September last year, its talks to sell the rest of Argos to Chinese online retailer JD.com fell through.Sainsbury's chief executive Simon Roberts said that all of Argos's nearly 14,000 staff would be transferred over to Swift Partners as part of the deal.He also confirmed that Argos would continue to operate in Sainsbury's shops; Nectar will continue to be used across both Argos and Sainsbury's; and Sainsbury's will continue to sell Habitat productsSwift Partners' Pennycook said he believed "strongly in Argos's future and see real opportunities to invest and build on its progress".The deal is expected to be completed in February next year.Pennycook said there was the potential to open new standalone Argos shops – and did not rule out the possibility of the return of its print catalogue.Retail expert Catherine Shuttleworth said Argos has been a "distraction" from Sainsbury's main food business.She said having new owners focused entirely on it gives Argos the potential to be a "really digital-first business".She praised the user-friendliness of its app and said its click-and-collect model, where customers can order something online and pick it up from an Argos shop the same day, means it can give a "bloody nose" to online retail giants like Amazon.Retail analyst Clive Black said he had always questioned whether Argos was "wholly aligned" with Sainsbury's grocery business, describing the supermarket group's attempt to sell Argos as "challenging and prolonged".He said Argos has been a "suboptimal performer from a financial perspective".In Sainsbury's latest results for the first three months of this year, group-wide sales were up 3.1%, although sales for Argos specifically had dipped 0.5%.Bally Auluk, national officer at Usdaw, a union which represents Argos workers, said the announcement would create uncertainty, but that it welcomed Swift's commitment to "keeping the model of store in stores, standalone stores and local fulfilment centres".
contentParagraphs.zh: Sainsbury’s 同意以 1.2 亿英镑的价格出售 Argos，因为这家连锁超市旨在专注于其主要食品业务。Sainsbury’s 表示，对于 Argos 的客户、员工和供应商来说，这将是“一切照常”。购物者不会看到任何变化，因为 Argos 仍将在 Sainsbury's 商店运营，销售 Habitat 产品并提供 Nectar 积分。买家 Swift Partners 是一家为购买该品牌而创建的公司，其中包括前 Co-operative Group 老板 Richard Pennycook。Argos 在英国各地有 667 家商店，其中 201 家作为独立商店运营，466 家在 Sainsbury's 内运营。它还拥有 450 多个收集点。Argos 成立于 1973 年，开设了商店，顾客可以在其中浏览其目录并下订单，产品从与商店相连的仓库运送到收银台。Argos 目录曾经被喜剧演员比尔·贝利描述为“梦想的层压书”，曾经是一本实体书。Argos 不再印刷这本厚重的书，现在全系列产品都可以在网上购买。在商店里，顾客可以在平板电脑上浏览产品系列。一段时间以来，Sainsbury's 一直试图出售 Argos，该品牌一直被视为表现不佳的品牌。Sainsbury's 于 2016 年以 14 亿英镑的价格收购了 Argos，以及 Habitat 和 Home Retail Group 旗下的所有其他零售品牌。随后，它在2024年以约7.2亿英镑的价格出售了运营Argos卡的Argos金融服务公司。去年9月，其将Argos剩余部分出售给中国在线零售商京东的谈判失败。塞恩斯伯里首席执行官西蒙·罗伯茨(Simon Roberts)表示，作为交易的一部分，Argos的近14,000名员工将全部转移到Swift Partners。他还证实，Argos将继续在塞恩斯伯里运营。商店； Nectar 将继续在 Argos 和 Sainsbury's 中使用； Swift Partners 的 Pennycook 表示，他“对 Argos 的未来充满信心，并看到了投资和发展其进步的真正机会”。该交易预计将于明年 2 月完成。Pennycook 表示，有可能开设新的独立 Argos 商店，并且不排除返回其印刷目录的可能性。零售专家 Catherine Shuttleworth 表示，Argos 已经“分散了人们的注意力”。塞恩斯伯里的主要食品业务。她说，新的所有者完全专注于它，使 Argos 有潜力成为“真正的数字优先企业”。她赞扬了其应用程序的用户友好性，并表示其点击提货模式，客户可以在线订购商品，并在当天从 Argos 商店提货，这意味着它可以给亚马逊等在线零售巨头带来“血腥的鼻子”。零售分析师克莱夫·布莱克表示，他一直质疑 Argos 是否与“完全一致” Sainsbury的杂货业务称，该超市集团出售Argos的尝试“具有挑战性且旷日持久”。他表示，Argos“从财务角度来看表现不佳”。在Sainsbury今年前三个月的最新业绩中，集团整体销售额增长了3.1%，尽管Argos的销售额具体下降了0.5%。代表Argos工人的工会Usdaw的国家官员巴利·奥卢克(Bally Auluk)表示该公告将带来不确定性，但它欢迎 Swift 承诺“保持商店、独立商店和本地配送中心的商店模式”。

articles.title: England and Wales on course for driest July on record
articles.summary: Met Office records indicate England and Wales are likely to have had their driest July since records began 190 years ago.
articles.titleZh: 英格兰和威尔士将迎来有记录以来最干燥的七月
articles.summaryZh: 英国气象局的记录显示，英格兰和威尔士可能经历了自 190 年前有记录以来最干燥的 7 月。

contentParagraphs.en: July looks like it will be one of the warmest on record for much of the UK.The Met Office's provisional statistics up to 30 July show Wales on course for it warmest July for mean temperature, which is the average across each 24-hour period.By the same measure, England looks on course for its joint warmest July and Northern Ireland its third warmest.Scotland is not on course for mean July temperatures within its top 10.Whilst maximum temperatures have not set records, July's high so far being 35.5C at Wisley in Surrey on the 9th, compared to July's record of 40.3C set in 2022 in Coningsby, Lincolnshire, mean temperatures across southern England have been particularly high, at 3.2C above average.England is on track this year for the highest number of heat-related deaths since records began, according to estimates by the UK Health Security Agency.In a preliminary assessment, it said there were an estimated 2,877 heat-related deaths during the May and June heatwaves, almost double the figure for the whole of last year.The UK has had seven days with temperatures over 35C so far this year, beating the previous record of five set in 1976 and equalled in 2020. There have been 31 days with temperatures over 30C, not far off the record of 34 days set in 1995 and comfortably beating 1976, which had 24 days.
contentParagraphs.zh: 7 月看起来将是英国大部分地区有记录以来最热的月份之一。英国气象局截至 7 月 30 日的临时统计数据显示，威尔士将迎来平均气温（每个 24 小时期间的平均值）最热的 7 月。按照同样的标准，英格兰有望迎来并列最热的 7 月，而北爱尔兰则将是第三热的 7 月。苏格兰 7 月平均气温并未进入前 10 名。虽然最高气温尚未创下记录，但 7 月的最高气温是迄今为止的最高值萨里郡威斯利9日气温为35.5摄氏度，与林肯郡科宁斯比2022年创下的7月最高气温40.3摄氏度相比，英格兰南部的平均气温特别高，比平均气温高出3.2摄氏度。据英国卫生安全局估计，今年英格兰因高温死亡人数有望创下有记录以来的最高纪录。初步评估称，估计有2877人死亡。 5 月和 6 月热浪期间与高温相关的死亡人数几乎是去年全年的两倍。今年迄今为止，英国已有 7 天气温超过 35 摄氏度，打破了 1976 年创下的 5 天气温超过 30 摄氏度的记录，2020 年追平了这一记录。已有 31 天气温超过 30 摄氏度，与 1995 年创下的 34 天记录相差不远，轻松超过了 1976 年的 24 天。

articles.title: In the race for Senate in Michigan, multiple party fights are colliding for Democrats
articles.summary: As Haley Stevens and Abdul El-Sayed vie for the Democratic nomination, voters are debating which way the party should go: establishment or insurgent; progressive or more moderate; new media or old.
articles.titleZh: 在密歇根州参议员竞选中，民主党的多党斗争正在发生冲突
articles.summaryZh: 当海莉·史蒂文斯和阿卜杜勒·赛义德争夺民主党提名时，选民们正在争论该党应该走哪条路：建制派还是叛乱派；渐进或更温和；新媒体还是旧媒体。

contentParagraphs.en: Haley Stevens and Abdul El-Sayed are locked in a close race to be the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Michigan.
contentParagraphs.zh: 海莉·史蒂文斯 (Haley Stevens) 和阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛义德 (Abdul El-Sayed) 正在争夺密歇根州美国参议院的民主党提名。

contentParagraphs.en: Sylvia Jarrus for NPR
contentParagraphs.zh: NPR 的西尔维娅·贾勒斯

contentParagraphs.en: Sylvia Jarrus for NPR
contentParagraphs.zh: NPR 的西尔维娅·贾勒斯

contentParagraphs.en: DETROIT — After two years in the political wilderness, Democrats are feeling cautiously optimistic about turning the tide in the midterms. That has only intensified debate about the direction of the party.
contentParagraphs.zh: 底特律——在政治荒野中度过了两年之后，民主党人对在中期选举中扭转局势感到谨慎乐观。这只会加剧有关党的方向的争论。

contentParagraphs.en: Nowhere is that debate more fraught now than Michigan, where Democrats are weighing two millennial candidates for an open Senate seat.
contentParagraphs.zh: 现在，这场辩论最令人担忧的地方莫过于密歇根州，那里的民主党人正在权衡两名千禧一代候选人以获得一个空缺的参议院席位。

contentParagraphs.en: One is Abdul El-Sayed, an epidemiologist firing up progressives by embracing "Medicare for All" and ripping the influence of corporate money in politics.
contentParagraphs.zh: 其中之一是流行病学家阿卜杜勒·赛义德（Abdul El-Sayed），他通过拥抱“全民医疗保险”并削弱企业资金在政治中的影响力来激励进步人士。

contentParagraphs.en: The other is Haley Stevens, a four-term congresswoman who flipped a suburban House district and pledges to fight President Trump while still practicing a more moderate brand of politics.
contentParagraphs.zh: 另一位是海莉·史蒂文斯(Haley Stevens)，她是一位四届国会女议员，她推翻了郊区众议院选区，并承诺与特朗普总统作斗争，同时仍然奉行更为温和的政治风格。

contentParagraphs.en: "You have candidates who are very different," says Joel Rutherford, a Democrat from Warren, Mich. "This passion has just become so big. I try to tell people this is political, not personal."
contentParagraphs.zh: 来自密歇根州沃伦的民主党人乔尔·卢瑟福 (Joel Rutherford) 表示：“候选人的情况非常不同。这种热情变得如此之大。我试图告诉人们这是政治性的，而不是个人性的。”

contentParagraphs.en: It does not help that the race has become a proxy for so many debates Democrats are wrestling with: Establishment versus insurgent. Progressive versus more moderate. New media versus old.
contentParagraphs.zh: 这场竞选已成为民主党正在努力解决的众多辩论的代表：建制派与叛乱分子，这无济于事。进步与更温和。新媒体与旧媒体的对比。

contentParagraphs.en: And the stakes are high for Democrats. To win back the Senate, the party needs to net a total of four seats. But their path to the majority also depends on holding onto the seat in Michigan — infusing the choice voters make in Tuesday's primary with national implications.
contentParagraphs.zh: 对于民主党来说，赌注很高。为了赢回参议院，该党需要总共获得四个席位。但他们通往多数席位的道路还取决于能否保住密歇根州的席位——将选民在周二初选中做出的选择融入全国影响之中。

contentParagraphs.en: Two very different candidates
contentParagraphs.zh: 两个截然不同的候选人

contentParagraphs.en: Under a big pavilion in Warren, just outside of Detroit, where designers dream up new Chevys and Buicks for General Motors and the sprawling Warren Truck Plant churns out Jeeps, El-Sayed worked the crowd at an annual picnic in July with a live band, barbecue and games for retired members of the United Auto Workers.
contentParagraphs.zh: 在底特律郊外沃伦的一个大展馆下，设计师们为通用汽车设计了新款雪佛兰和别克汽车，而庞大的沃伦卡车工厂则生产吉普车。7 月份，埃尔-赛义德在一年一度的野餐会上为观众带来了现场乐队表演、烧烤和为美国汽车工人联合会退休成员举办的游戏。

contentParagraphs.en: Gwen Martin and her two friends were thrilled to see El-Sayed, who has the UAW endorsement. Martin, who says she has been intrigued by New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, says so many voters are just struggling to get by and are hungry for sweeping change.
contentParagraphs.zh: 格温·马丁 (Gwen Martin) 和她的两个朋友很高兴见到获得 UAW 认可的埃尔-赛义德 (El-Sayed)。马丁说，她对纽约市市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼很感兴趣，她说很多选民都在挣扎求生，渴望彻底的改变。

contentParagraphs.en: "It's a choice now between medicine or do you buy groceries or gas," Martin says.
contentParagraphs.zh: 马丁说：“现在你需要在药物和购买杂货或汽油之间做出选择。”

contentParagraphs.en: El-Sayed is pitching the kind of transformation Martin envisions. A former health department director for Detroit and later Wayne County who also ran for governor in 2018, El-Sayed says special interest money in politics is a driving force making problems like access to health care so intractable.
contentParagraphs.zh: 埃尔-赛义德正在推动马丁所设想的转型。埃尔-赛义德曾担任底特律和韦恩县卫生部门主任，并于 2018 年竞选州长。他表示，政治上的特殊利益资金是导致医疗保健等问题变得如此棘手的推动力。

contentParagraphs.en: "The problem too often with the Democratic party, we have an instinct to say the right thing, but we're bought off by the people who are on the side of doing the wrong thing," El-Sayed said in an interview. "So we're constantly hedging and pulling punches so we say not much of anything at all."
contentParagraphs.zh: 埃尔-赛义德在接受采访时说：“民主党经常遇到这样的问题，我们有一种本能地说正确的话，但我们却被那些站在一边做错误事情的人收买了。” “所以我们不断地对冲和克制，所以我们什么也没说。”

contentParagraphs.en: Dr. Abdul El-Sayed meets with voters and supporters in Rouge Park on July 26, 2026 in Detroit.
contentParagraphs.zh: 阿卜杜勒·赛义德博士于 2026 年 7 月 26 日在底特律 Rouge Park 会见选民和支持者。

contentParagraphs.en: Sylvia Jarrus for NPR
contentParagraphs.zh: NPR 的西尔维娅·贾勒斯

contentParagraphs.en: Sylvia Jarrus for NPR
contentParagraphs.zh: NPR 的西尔维娅·贾勒斯

contentParagraphs.en: Rose Edwards, 66, puts a sticker with her hopes for the future on a banner at a community meetup event for El-Sayed in Rouge Park on July 26, 2026 in Detroit. "You have to get involved in the community, you can't complain and then not get involved. I love him and he has my vote and I can't wait to see what he does when he gets to Washington," Edwards said.
contentParagraphs.zh: 2026 年 7 月 26 日，在底特律 Rouge Park 举行的 El-Sayed 社区聚会活动中，66 岁的罗斯·爱德华兹 (Rose Edwards) 在横幅上贴了一张写有她对未来希望的贴纸。 “你必须融入社区，你不能抱怨然后不参与。我爱他，他有我的选票，我迫不及待地想看看他到达华盛顿后会做什么，”爱德华兹说。

contentParagraphs.en: Sylvia Jarrus for NPR
contentParagraphs.zh: NPR 的西尔维娅·贾勒斯

contentParagraphs.en: Sylvia Jarrus for NPR
contentParagraphs.zh: NPR 的西尔维娅·贾勒斯

contentParagraphs.en: In Michigan, as in other Democratic primaries this year, the debate over special interest money has been felt most sharply in conversations around AIPAC. The pro-Israel lobbying group is spending millions to boost Stevens, a staunch supporter of Israel, and oppose El-Sayed, who supports ending U.S. military aid to the country.
contentParagraphs.zh: 在密歇根州，与今年其他民主党初选一样，关于特殊利息资金的争论在 AIPAC 周围的对话中最为激烈。这个亲以色列的游说团体正花费数百万美元来支持以色列的坚定支持者史蒂文斯，并反对支持结束美国对该国军事援助的埃尔赛义德。

contentParagraphs.en: That outside spending has helped flood mailboxes and the airwaves with advertisements. Multiple voters at the picnic questioned El-Sayed on a mailer they received, paid for by an AIPAC-affiliated super PAC, that accused him of making disparaging remarks about former First Lady Michelle Obama.
contentParagraphs.zh: 这些外部支出使得邮箱和广播中充斥着广告。野餐会上的多名选民在他们收到的一封由美国公共事务委员会下属的超级政治行动委员会支付的邮件中对埃尔·赛义德提出质疑，邮件指责他对前第一夫人米歇尔·奥巴马发表贬低性言论。

contentParagraphs.en: But Kelley McKenzie, retiring soon after a 33-year career in the auto industry, says that is not why she is leaning toward Stevens. McKenzie was at Chrysler when the auto industry neared collapse during the Great Recession. Stevens was chief of staff for the team President Obama tasked with rescuing Detroit's big three automakers.
contentParagraphs.zh: 但在汽车行业工作了 33 年后不久就退休的凯利·麦肯齐 (Kelley McKenzie) 表示，这并不是她倾向于史蒂文斯的原因。当大衰退期间汽车业濒临崩溃时，麦肯齐在克莱斯勒工作。史蒂文斯是奥巴马总统负责拯救底特律三大汽车制造商的团队的幕僚长。

contentParagraphs.en: As for what McKenzie wants from her party now, fighting President Trump is at the top of the list.
contentParagraphs.zh: 至于麦肯齐现在对她的政党的期望，与特朗普总统的斗争是首要任务。

contentParagraphs.en: "I want Democrats to get aggressive and fight fire with fire, not fire with water," she says.
contentParagraphs.zh: 她说：“我希望民主党人能够积极进取，以毒攻毒，而不是以水攻毒。”

contentParagraphs.en: In conversations with voters, Stevens pledges to fight, but she also describes herself as a workhorse.
contentParagraphs.zh: 在与选民的对话中，史蒂文斯承诺战斗，但她也将自己描述为一名主力。

contentParagraphs.en: "I'm just beating MAGA four times in my Congressional races, and I'm passing laws and I'm doing damn good work," she told reporters. "We don't need wishlists. We need action now. That's the Michigan way."
contentParagraphs.zh: 她对记者说：“我在国会竞选中四次击败了 MAGA，而且我正在通过法律，我的工作做得非常好。” “我们不需要愿望清单。我们现在需要采取行动。这就是密歇根的方式。”

articles.title: Snapchat joins other popular platforms in fight against 'AI slop'
articles.summary: Snapchat, YouTube, LinkedIn, and Substack are trying to combat the proliferation of fake AI content.
articles.titleZh: Snapchat 与其他流行平台一起对抗“人工智能滥用”
articles.summaryZh: Snapchat、YouTube、LinkedIn 和 Substack 正在努力打击虚假人工智能内容的扩散。

contentParagraphs.en: Snapchat has joined the likes of YouTube, LinkedIn and Substack in a growing effort to combat fake writing, images and videos that are entirely created by artificial intelligence (AI) tools.Such content, commonly called "AI slop", has proliferated online as the tech industry has raced to create a greater number of easier to use generative AI tools that can create anything from essays to realistic videos.Snap, the parent company of Snapchat, said on Friday that the platform would stop recommending "wholly AI-generated videos" in its popular Spotlight feed in favour of "authentic, human-made content."Over the past two weeks, YouTube, LinkedIn and Substack have unveiled similar strategies.Snap did not go so far as to try and prohibit all AI-generated content from Snapchat. The platform offers its own AI tools to alter content, and so AI "enhanced or edited" content will still be part of its recommendations to users.However, Snap acknowledged that entirely AI-generated content is typically "low-quality", "repetitive", and generally not what Snapchat users want to see.Recent research into the reception of AI-generated content shows that people tend to agree, external with those descriptions. Moreover, the more fake AI-generated content that people see in a social media feed, the less likely, external they are to think that any of the content they're being shown online is genuine, according to a separate survey.As Chris Best, the co-founder and chief executive of Substack put it last week: "It's getting harder to tell what's real on the internet."Announcing a new tool, external designed to let readers on the newsletter platform detect AI-generated writing, Best cited other research that has found up to 40% of writing on social media is now fake or AI-generated."Platforms that reward fakeness will create a race to the bottom," Best said.LinkedIn, a social media platform focused on work, introduced a button on its platform this week that allows any user to report if a post or a comment appears to be AI-generated."AI slop is a top priority for all of us," LinkedIn's chief product officer Hari Srinivasan wrote on the platform.In just the last couple of months, he said the platform had "blocked billions" of attempts to post AI-generated comments. "Every day we are now catching hundreds of thousands of automated comment attempts," Srinivasan said.Like Snap, LinkedIn said it is not rejecting the use of AI entirely and users that use AI tools to "refine" their posts should not get caught up in efforts to combat AI slop.Nonetheless, LinkedIn is removing an automated prompt that would show up for users writing a post offering to "enhance" it through the use of AI. It will go back to a simple proofreading tool.YouTube, the video platform owned by Google, also this month updated its policies, external around what kind of content can be monetised by creators.Research from last year found scores of channels on YouTube that were solely AI-generated content, external, many of which had millions of subscribers and some of which made millions of dollars in revenue.In an effort to discourage YouTube from filling up with what the platform calls "inauthentic content", earlier this month the site broke down into three categories the kind of videos that will not be allowed to make money through it: generic, repetitive, or template-based. Those styles of content are much easier to make, and quickly, with the use of generative AI tools.YouTube's trust and safety chief Matt Halprin said in an interview, external on the updated rules that, while AI tools can help people with their content, they are more frequently being used to create fake and low-quality videos."The same technology really enables great stuff," Halprin said."But it also enables stuff that's kind of content farming, and that's the stuff that we don't want to have."
contentParagraphs.zh: Snapchat 与 YouTube、LinkedIn 和 Substack 等公司一起，不断努力打击完全由人工智能 (AI) 工具创建的虚假文字、图像和视频。随着科技行业竞相创建更多更易于使用的生成式 AI 工具，这些工具可以创建从文章到逼真视频的任何内容，此类内容（通常称为“AI slop”）在网上激增。Snapchat 的母公司 Snap 周五表示，该平台将停止推荐“完全由 AI 生成”过去两周，YouTube、LinkedIn 和 Substack 都推出了类似的策略。Snap 并没有尝试禁止 Snapchat 上的所有人工智能生成内容。该平台提供自己的人工智能工具来更改内容，因此人工智能“增强或编辑”的内容仍将是其向用户推荐的一部分。不过，Snap 承认，完全由人工智能生成的内容通常是“低质量”、“重复”的，通常不是 Snapchat 用户希望看到的内容。最近对人工智能生成内容的接受情况的研究表明，人们倾向于同意外部描述。此外，根据另一项调查，人们在社交媒体中看到的人工智能生成的虚假内容越多，他们就越不可能认为自己在网上显示的任何内容都是真实的。正如 Substack 联合创始人兼首席执行官克里斯·贝斯特 (Chris Best) 上周所说：“辨别互联网上的真实内容变得越来越困难。”贝斯特宣布推出一款新工具，旨在让时事通讯平台上的读者检测人工智能生成的写作，贝斯特引用了其他研究，这些研究发现现在社交媒体上的文章有 40% 是假的或人工智能生成的。贝斯特说：“奖励虚假的平台将引发逐底竞争。”专注于工作的社交媒体平台 LinkedIn 本周在其平台上推出了一个按钮，允许任何用户报告是否有帖子或评论似乎是人工智能生成的。“人工智能垃圾是我们所有人的首要任务，”LinkedIn 首席产品官哈里·斯里尼瓦桑 (Hari Srinivasan) 在该平台上写道。表示该平台已“阻止了数十亿次”发布人工智能生成评论的尝试。斯里尼瓦桑说：“我们现在每天都会收到数十万条自动评论尝试。”与 Snap 一样，LinkedIn 也表示，它并不完全拒绝使用人工智能，使用人工智能工具“完善”其帖子的用户不应陷入对抗人工智能失范的努力中。尽管如此，LinkedIn 正在删除一个自动提示，该提示会在用户撰写帖子时显示，旨在通过使用人工智能“增强”帖子。它将回归到一个简单的校对工具。谷歌旗下的视频平台 YouTube 也在本月更新了其政策，围绕什么样的内容可以被创作者货币化。去年的研究发现，YouTube 上有数十个完全由人工智能生成的内容，外部频道，其中许多频道拥有数百万订阅者，其中一些频道赚取了数百万美元的收入。为了阻止 YouTube 充斥该平台所谓的“不真实内容”，本月早些时候，该网站将其分为三类：不允许通过其赚钱的视频：通用、重复或基于模板。通过使用生成式人工智能工具，制作这些风格的内容变得更加容易，而且速度也更快。YouTube 的信任和安全主管马特·哈尔普林 (Matt Halprin) 在接受采访时表示，尽管人工智能工具可以帮助人们处理内容，但它们更频繁地被用来制作虚假和低质量的视频。“同样的技术确实可以带来伟大的东西，”哈尔普林说。“但它也使内容农业的东西成为可能，而这正是我们不希望拥有的东西。”

articles.title: Passenger on British Airways mayday flight describes fear and shout of 'I don't want to die'
articles.summary: Edward Killiwick was on the flight that issued a distress call, before it landed safely at Heathrow earlier this month.
articles.titleZh: 英国航空求救航班上的乘客描述了恐惧并大喊“我不想死”
articles.summaryZh: 本月早些时候，爱德华·基利威克乘坐的航班在希思罗机场安全降落之前发出了求救信号。

contentParagraphs.en: A passenger on a British Airways flight that issued a distress call on approach to Heathrow Airport earlier this month has described the rising fear in the cabin and a lack of information from the crew.Edward Killiwick had been travelling back from a friend's birthday party with his partner Julie, on the flight from Dusseldorf in Germany on 6 July.He said passengers were told that the landing had been aborted, and then he felt a "very violent manoeuvre" and "did think we could crash". He and his partner had to comfort a woman who "completely lost it and started screaming, 'I don't want to die'".The flight landed safely, but the incident is being investigated with assistance from BA.The UK's Air Accidents Investigation Branch (AAIB) said it was "investigating a serious incident", and France's accident investigation authority, the BEA, said on Wednesday that the plane, an Airbus A320, had issued a distress call.Edward said: "The violent manoeuvre almost felt like it was avoiding another aircraft. You could feel the engines going at full power."It was a bit odd going around in a holding pattern with no information. I thought if they're not talking, then they're not in a good place."He said they were in a holding pattern for about 15 minutes.The BEA said that as the plane approached Heathrow, there was a data system failure which triggered a stall warning.The crew then flew the aircraft in a different mode called "alternate law", which removes some automated flight protection systems. Another stall warning then occurred at 3,000 feet — which experts say was likely to have been just miles away from the airport.The urgency call the crew had already made was upgraded to mayday, indicating imminent danger.A British Airways spokesperson said the airline was assisting the AAIB with its investigation and was not legally able to comment further at this stage.Edward said: "I was definitely scared. After the violent manoeuvre I thought, there is definitely something very badly wrong here. I did think we could crash. "I did think it was a possibility, and I think everyone else did."He added: "I think everyone was getting very scared, including one lady who completely lost it and started screaming 'I don't want to die.'"Then we did land, but still no communication from the flight deck, which I suppose isn't surprising as I suppose they had quite a lot to do."Several fire trucks and a police car were on the tarmac when the plane landed, Edward said."There was a few people that did clap, but not that many because I think everyone was just relieved to be on the ground," he said."Everyone was very, very quiet. There was almost no conversation. That's the eerie thing."Julie, my partner, did shed a few tears when we landed."With additional reporting from Katy Austin
contentParagraphs.zh: 本月早些时候，英国航空公司一架航班在接近希思罗机场时发出求救信号，一名乘客描述了机舱内日益加剧的恐惧感以及机组人员缺乏信息的情况。爱德华·基利威克 (Edward Killiwick) 7 月 6 日乘坐从德国杜塞尔多夫出发的航班，与伴侣朱莉 (Julie) 参加完朋友的生日聚会后返回。他说，乘客被告知着陆已中止，然后他感到“非常剧烈的动作”，“确实认为我们可能会坠毁”。他和他的伴侣不得不安慰一名“完全失去理智并开始尖叫‘我不想死’”的女子。飞机安全着陆，但该事件正在英国航空的协助下进行调查。英国航空事故调查部门（AAIB）表示正在“调查一起严重事故”，法国事故调查机构 BEA 周三表示，这架空客 A320 飞机已发出求救信号。爱德华说：“剧烈的机动几乎感觉像是在躲避另一架飞机，你可以感觉到发动机全速运转。“在没有任何信息的情况下以等待模式飞行有点奇怪。我想如果他们不说话，那么他们的处境就不好。”他说他们处于等待状态大约 15 分钟。BEA 表示，当飞机接近希思罗机场时，数据系统出现故障，触发了失速警告。机组人员随后以一种称为“替代法则”的不同模式驾驶飞机，该模式取消了一些自动飞行保护系统。随后在 3,000 英尺处发生了另一个失速警告，专家称该位置可能距离飞机仅数英里。机组人员已经发出的紧急呼叫升级为求救信号，表明危险迫在眉睫。英国航空公司发言人表示，该航空公司正在协助AAIB进行调查，现阶段无法在法律上进一步发表评论。爱德华说：“我确实很害怕。经历了剧烈的动作之后，我想，这里肯定有什么非常严重的问题。我确实认为我们可能会崩溃。 “我确实认为这是有可能的，我想其他人也这么认为。”他补充道：“我想每个人都变得非常害怕，包括一位女士，她完全失去了理智，开始尖叫‘我不想死’。”“然后我们确实着陆了，但驾驶舱仍然没有任何通讯，我想这并不奇怪，因为我认为他们有很多事情要做。”爱德华说，飞机着陆时，几辆消防车和一辆警车停在停机坪上。确实鼓掌了，但不是那么多，因为我认为每个人都因为躺在地上而松了一口气，”他说。“每个人都非常非常安静。几乎没有交谈。这就是令人毛骨悚然的事情。“当我们着陆时，我的搭档朱莉确实流下了几滴眼泪。”凯蒂·奥斯汀的补充报道

articles.title: Where to see the biggest solar eclipse since 1999
articles.summary: The UK's biggest solar eclipse since 1999 arrives on 12 August. Here's where to see it safely.
articles.titleZh: 哪里可以观赏 1999 年以来最大的日食
articles.summaryZh: 英国自 1999 年以来最大的日食将于 8 月 12 日到来。这是安全观看它的地方。

contentParagraphs.en: According to Royal Museums Greenwich, viewers in the West Country will see the eclipse begin at 18:17 BST.The maximum eclipse will occur at 19:12 BST, before the event ends at 20:06 BST.Because the eclipse takes place during the evening, a clear view of the western horizon will be key.Simon Holbeche, chair of the Bath Astronomers, said: "Other than the weather, the only other criteria is a good view all the way to the horizon looking West."This is because it's an evening eclipse and the sun/moon will be dropping closer to the horizon during the eclipse."So, in terms of locations, some might choose to pop upstairs if the house is westerly facing, or pop up the local treeless hills, [for example in Bath that could be] Roundhill, Twerton or Little Solsbury Hill."Astronomers recommend elevated locations with unobstructed views to the west.BristolThe Downs Sea Walls Viewpoint, Clifton with Bristol astronomers, Victoria Park and Brandon Hill and Cabot Tower. WalesCardiff, Gower Peninsula, Swansea, and Rest Bay Beach, Porthcawl.WiltshireWarminster Town Park with Starquest Astronomy Club, Cley Hill, Avebury Stone Circle and Barbury Castle.GloucestershireCleeve Hill, near Cheltenham, Robinswood Hill, Gloucester and Chosen Hill.SomersetWells Cathedral Green with the Wells & Mendip Astronomers, Beckford Tower with the Bath Astronomers and Little Solsbury Hill.Devon Exmoor National Park, Norman Lockyer Observatory, Sidmouth and The Poltimore Inn, North Molton, with the Space Detectives.South West and CornwallLowery Cross Car Park, Plymouth with Plymouth Astonomical Society, Penzance and Sennen, near Lands End.Isles of Scilly St Mary's Island, from Hugh Town, West facing beaches and Community Observatory, St Martins.
contentParagraphs.zh: 据格林威治皇家博物馆称，英国西部地区的观众将在英国夏令时 18:17 开始看到日食。最大日食将在英国夏令时 19:12 发生，活动在英国夏令时 20:06 结束。由于日食发生在晚上，因此西部地平线的清晰视野将是关键。巴斯天文学家主席西蒙·霍尔贝什 (Simon Holbeche) 表示：“除了天气之外，唯一的标准就是能清楚地看到整个日食。” “这是因为这是一个傍晚的日食，日食期间太阳/月亮会落到更接近地平线的位置。所以，就位置而言，如果房子朝西，有些人可能会选择上楼，或者选择当地没有树木的山丘，[例如在巴斯，可能是朗德希尔、特沃顿或小索尔斯伯里山。”天文学家建议选择地势较高的位置，西边的景色一览无余。布里斯托尔唐斯海沃尔斯观景台、克利夫顿与布里斯托尔天文学家、维多利亚公园、布兰登山和卡伯特塔。威尔士卡迪夫、高尔半岛、斯旺西和休息湾海滩、波斯考尔。威尔特郡沃明斯特镇公园，有星际探索天文俱乐部、克利山、埃夫伯里石圈和巴伯里城堡。格洛斯特郡克利夫山，靠近切尔滕纳姆、罗宾斯伍德山、格洛斯特和乔森山。萨默塞特威尔斯大教堂绿地，有威尔斯和门迪普天文学家、贝克福德塔、巴斯天文学家和小索尔斯伯里山。德文埃克斯穆尔国家公园、诺曼洛克耶天文台、西德茅斯和波尔蒂莫尔旅馆、北莫尔顿，与太空侦探。普利茅斯西南和康沃尔洛厄里十字停车场以及普利茅斯天文学会、彭赞斯和森南，靠近地角。锡利群岛圣玛丽岛，从休镇出发，朝西的海滩和社区天文台，圣马丁斯。

articles.title: Nurses chase Cyclospora using grocery receipts, food apps and detailed interviews
articles.summary: Public health nurses have been pulled from other duties in Washtenaw County, MI, to call hundreds of people sick with cyclosporiasis, and try to help them remember everything they ate in recent days.
articles.titleZh: 护士利用杂货收据、食品应用程序和详细访谈来追踪环孢子虫
articles.summaryZh: 密歇根州沃什特诺县的公共卫生护士被抽调出其他职责，为数百名患有环孢子虫病的人打电话，并试图帮助他们记住最近几天吃过的所有东西。

contentParagraphs.en: Linda Kim, a nurse at the Washtenaw County Health Department in Michigan, has been helping to investigate more than 900 cases of cyclosporiasis locally. Foodborne illnesses are some of the most complex public health investigations, especially with the Cyclospora parasite. That's because symptoms may not appear for up to two weeks after someone's eaten contaminated food.
contentParagraphs.zh: 密歇根州沃什特诺县卫生部门的护士琳达·金 (Linda Kim) 一直在帮助调查当地 900 多例环孢子虫病病例。食源性疾病是最复杂的公共卫生调查之一，尤其是环孢子虫寄生虫。这是因为在食用受污染的食物后，症状可能最多两周内不会出现。

contentParagraphs.en: Kate Wells/KFF Health News
contentParagraphs.zh: 凯特·威尔斯/KFF健康新闻

contentParagraphs.en: Kate Wells/KFF Health News
contentParagraphs.zh: 凯特·威尔斯/KFF健康新闻

contentParagraphs.en: More than 900 people in Washtenaw County, Michigan have been sickened with cyclosporiasis since mid-June. Linda Kim, a public health nurse, has spoken to more than 100 of them.
contentParagraphs.zh: 自 6 月中旬以来，密歇根州沃什特诺县已有 900 多人患有环孢子虫病。公共卫生护士琳达·金 (Linda Kim) 已与其中 100 多人交谈过。

contentParagraphs.en: Almost everyone's said the same thing: It's excruciating, and one of the worst illnesses they've experienced.
contentParagraphs.zh: 几乎每个人都说了同样的话：这是令人痛苦的，也是他们经历过的最严重的疾病之一。

contentParagraphs.en: But on a Wednesday in July, she called one man who said he wouldn't mind having it again, actually.
contentParagraphs.zh: 但在七月的一个星期三，她打电话给一名男子，这名男子说他不介意再次拥有它，事实上。

contentParagraphs.en: "You're enjoying the weight loss?" Kim said, laughing as she took notes in a small conference room at the Washtenaw County Health Department building, just outside Ann Arbor. "Well, I'm glad to hear that. At least you got something good out of it!"
contentParagraphs.zh: “你享受减肥的乐趣吗？”金在安娜堡郊外沃什特诺县卫生局大楼的一间小会议室里笑着说。 “嗯，我很高兴听到这个消息。至少你从中得到了一些好处！”

contentParagraphs.en: From one crisis to the next
contentParagraphs.zh: 从一场危机到下一场危机

contentParagraphs.en: Normally, Kim's supposed to be working downstairs in the clinic, where families wait in the gray plastic chairs in the lobby for free or low-cost immunizations. But she hasn't been there in months.
contentParagraphs.zh: 通常情况下，金应该在诊所楼下工作，家人在大厅的灰色塑料椅子上等待免费或低成本的免疫接种。但她已经好几个月没去过那里了。

contentParagraphs.en: In March, Kim was transferred to a different department to help deal with a local measles outbreak that sickened seven people in the county, five of them children. It was an all-hands-on-deck situation; everyone worked overtime. The state issued an advisory urging families in Washtenaw and surrounding counties to get their babies 6 months or older vaccinated ahead of schedule, if possible.
contentParagraphs.zh: 今年三月，金被调到另一个部门，帮助应对当地爆发的麻疹疫情，该县有七人患病，其中五人是儿童。这是一种全员齐心协力的局面。大家都加班。该州发布了一份建议，敦促沃什特诺及周边县的家庭在可能的情况下提前为 6 个月或以上的婴儿接种疫苗。

contentParagraphs.en: Those contact-tracing calls for measles could be contentious, Kim said. People were suspicious, asking her how she knew they had tested positive, or why they should give her any information.
contentParagraphs.zh: 金说，这些针对麻疹的接触者追踪呼吁可能会引起争议。人们很怀疑，问她怎么知道他们的检测结果呈阳性，或者为什么他们应该向她提供任何信息。

contentParagraphs.en: "People were like, 'Oh, you're just trying to restrict my life,' or 'You're just trying to get information out of me and get me in trouble,'" she said. "It's like, no, we're actually not doing that at all."
contentParagraphs.zh: “人们的反应是，‘哦，你只是想限制我的生活’，或者‘你只是想从我嘴里套出信息，让我陷入麻烦’，”她说。 “就像，不，我们实际上根本没有这样做。”

contentParagraphs.en: Public health nurse Linda Kim also did contact tracing during a measles outbreak in Washtenaw County, Mich. She says the cyclosporiasis patients have been much more forthcoming, even volunteering intimate details about their distressing gastrointestinal symptoms. In contrast, some of the people she called regarding measles were more suspicious about her questions and her reasons for trying to track exposures.
contentParagraphs.zh: 公共卫生护士琳达·金(Linda Kim)还在密歇根州沃什特诺县麻疹爆发期间进行了接触者追踪。她说，环孢子虫病患者的态度要积极得多，甚至自愿提供有关他们令人痛苦的胃肠道症状的详细信息。相比之下，她就麻疹问题致电的一些人对她的问题以及她试图追踪接触情况的原因更加怀疑。

contentParagraphs.en: Kate Wells/KFF Health News
contentParagraphs.zh: 凯特·威尔斯/KFF健康新闻

contentParagraphs.en: Kate Wells/KFF Health News
contentParagraphs.zh: 凯特·威尔斯/KFF健康新闻

contentParagraphs.en: As she tried to explain to them, tracing the spread of the highly contagious virus and publicizing possible exposure sites was an effort to "keep it contained, so it doesn't become something huge."
contentParagraphs.zh: 正如她试图向他们解释的那样，追踪这种高度传染性病毒的传播并公布可能的暴露地点是为了“控制住它，这样它就不会变成大事”。

contentParagraphs.en: The county's measles outbreak ended in late May. Then in June, reports of cyclosporiasis cases started pouring in: more than 10,000 so far in Michigan.
contentParagraphs.zh: 该县的麻疹疫情于五月下旬结束。然后在 6 月份，有关环孢子虫病病例的报告开始大量涌入：密歇根州迄今已有 10,000 多例。

contentParagraphs.en: The cyclosporiasis surveillance has been different, Kim says. Now, people seem eager to divulge even the most graphic details of their illness, such as "pooping their beds, and, like, putting down towels and it's not enough."
contentParagraphs.zh: Kim 说，环孢子虫病的监测有所不同。现在，人们似乎渴望透露他们疾病的最生动的细节，例如“在床上大便，以及放下毛巾，但这还不够。”

contentParagraphs.en: Since she's a nurse, such confessions don't faze her, Kim said. Still, they have hundreds of these calls to make, so they try to keep each conversation to under an hour.
contentParagraphs.zh: 金说，由于她是一名护士，这样的坦白不会让她感到困扰。尽管如此，他们还是要打数百个这样的电话，因此他们尽量将每次通话时间控制在一个小时以内。

contentParagraphs.en: Before reports of cyclosporiasis cases started pouring in this summer, Washtenaw County Health Department staff in Michigan were working to contain a measles outbreak with contact tracing and testing. The county's outbreak ended in May.
contentParagraphs.zh: 今年夏天，在环孢子虫病病例报告大量涌现之前，密歇根州沃什特诺县卫生部门的工作人员正在努力通过接触者追踪和检测来控制麻疹疫情。该县的疫情于五月结束。

contentParagraphs.en: Kate Wells/KFF Health News
contentParagraphs.zh: 凯特·威尔斯/KFF健康新闻

contentParagraphs.en: Kate Wells/KFF Health News
contentParagraphs.zh: 凯特·威尔斯/KFF健康新闻

contentParagraphs.en: But foodborne illness investigations are complex. Especially for this parasite, Cyclospora. Symptoms can take as long as two weeks to appear after people have eaten contaminated food. And no one remembers what they ate two weeks ago, public health staffers said. The interview process can be extremely detailed. Kim and her colleagues ask people to pull up their restaurant receipts, scroll through purchases on their grocery store apps, even try to recall details such as the exact brand of bagged salad mix they bought, or the type of taco they got at Taco Bell.
contentParagraphs.zh: 但食源性疾病的调查很复杂。特别是对于这种寄生虫，环孢子虫。人们食用受污染的食物后，症状可能需要长达两周的时间才会出现。公共卫生工作人员表示，没有人记得自己两周前吃了什么。面试过程可能非常详细。金和她的同事要求人们调出餐厅收据，在杂货店应用程序上滚动浏览购买的商品，甚至尝试回忆一些细节，例如他们购买的袋装沙拉混合物的确切品牌，或者他们在塔可钟购买的炸玉米饼类型。

contentParagraphs.en: "Is that the crunchy one or the soft one?" Kim asked on a recent call, typing on a laptop decorated with cat and vaccine-themed stickers.
contentParagraphs.zh: “那个是脆的还是软的？”金在最近的一次通话中问道，他在一台贴有猫和疫苗主题贴纸的笔记本电脑上打字。

contentParagraphs.en: Tracing the sources of outbreaks amid funding cuts
contentParagraphs.zh: 在资金削减的情况下追踪疫情源头

contentParagraphs.en: Kim has been working with the health department for two years, a period defined by federal funding cuts.
contentParagraphs.zh: 金已经在卫生部门工作了两年，这段时期是联邦资金削减的时期。

contentParagraphs.en: Laina Stebbins, a spokesperson for the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services, said the Trump administration's sweeping cuts to public health grants eliminated a contract between the state health department and 44 of the state's 45 local departments that funded 123 full-time employees.
contentParagraphs.zh: 密歇根州卫生与公共服务部发言人莱娜·斯特宾斯(Laina Stebbins)表示，特朗普政府大幅削减公共卫生拨款，导致该州卫生部门与该州45个地方部门中的44个部门之间签订的合同被取消，该部门为123名全职员工提供资金。

contentParagraphs.en: Those cuts also impacted the state's disease surveillance labs, "reducing funding for equipment maintenance contracts, data modernization and the ability to innovate laboratory processes during emerging disease response," Stebbins said.
contentParagraphs.zh: 斯特宾斯说，这些削减还影响了该州的疾病监测实验室，“减少了设备维护合同、数据现代化以及在新出现的疾病应对过程中创新实验室流程的资金”。

contentParagraphs.en: Some of that funding was restored after Michigan won a temporary restraining order against the Trump administration. But Washtenaw's health department still had to scale back some disease surveillance and outbreak response work. Currently, employees who leave or retire aren't replaced, except for those on the nursing team, which is hiring but still understaffed.
contentParagraphs.zh: 在密歇根州赢得针对特朗普政府的临时限制令后，部分资金得到恢复。但沃什特诺卫生部门仍不得不缩减一些疾病监测和疫情应对工作。目前，离职或退休的员工没有被替换，除了护理团队的员工，该团队正在招聘但仍然人手不足。

contentParagraphs.en: Staff at the Washtenaw County Health Department in Ypsilanti, Michigan, work to trace the source of the outbreak by conducting detailed, often lengthy interviews with hundreds of people.
contentParagraphs.zh: 密歇根州伊普西兰蒂沃什特诺县卫生部门的工作人员通过对数百人进行详细且往往很长的采访来追踪疫情的源头。

contentParagraphs.en: Kate Wells/KFF Health News
contentParagraphs.zh: 凯特·威尔斯/KFF健康新闻

contentParagraphs.en: Kate Wells/KFF Health News
contentParagraphs.zh: 凯特·威尔斯/KFF健康新闻

contentParagraphs.en: The county's Health Equity Council, which aims to reduce health disparities, including in mental health, was also shuttered suddenly in early 2025. Nearly a year later, it resumed its work, with funding at least through this September.
contentParagraphs.zh: 该县旨在减少健康差距（包括心理健康方面）的健康公平委员会也在 2025 年初突然关闭。近一年后，该委员会恢复了工作，资金至少持续到今年 9 月。
